svg.title: Zones cover 872 km² of land in Guam and the Northern Mariana Islands with assumed links, and 531 to 647 km² without them

cc:Work.dc:title: Zones cover 872 km² of land in Guam and the Northern Mariana Islands with assumed links, and 531 to 647 km² without them
cc:Work.dc:description: Map of Guam and the Northern Mariana Islands. Blue AIS route cells fan west and northwest of Guam and reach Apra Harbor; one purple line of assumed link cells runs northeast from Apra Harbor through Rota and Tinian to Saipan. Land within 25 km of a route cell is dark: 872 of 1,019 km² (86%). Land outside the zone, 147 km², lies on islands north of 16 degrees north, which the map does not show.
